title: Debrief beyond ROSC
openingNarrative: The library called help; the ambulance performed CPR; the resuscitation bay restored sustained circulation; ICU care and this debrief continue afterward. Review the pathway: infection–renal trade-offs, consent under scanning, airway branch consequences, sedation and access, home or school continuity. Survival alone is not the score. Rohan’s question to the learner waits in the debrief generator: NOW ASK ME WHAT HAPPENS NEXT.

disabilityRightsNotes: Debrief continues beyond ROSC by design.
Do not score success only through survival or physiological improvement.
Identify rights-preserving moves alongside clinical ones.
debriefNotes: Prompt 13 categories are implemented by the debrief engine using choice history and domain deltas.
Required beats: one clinically strong decision, one rights-preserving decision, one delayed-harm decision, one legitimate uncertainty, one question Rohan would ask.
Next-episode hook must keep chronology lock intact.
